honesty_notice: All measurements were collected on the local benchmark host using real OS files, syscall.Fallocate (FALLOC_FL_PUNCH_HOLE), syscall.Stat_t.Blocks, and /proc/self/io. Flash wear and $/TB-month TCO values combine measured Logical WAF and physical space amplification with explicit DriveEconomics model parameters; they are local host measurements and parameterized model outputs, not production Hanzo cluster guarantees until reproduced on target NVMe hardware.

spec.name: zipfian_hot_cold_churn
spec.description: Zipfian (s=1.10) hot-cold S3 object churn (16-64 KiB objects, 75% overwrite / 15% delete / 10% fresh put)

spec.name: uniform_random_churn
spec.description: Uniform random overwrites & deletes over 32 KiB objects (worst-case mixed-age segments for copy-compaction)

spec.name: large_object_bulk_deletes
spec.description: Large 128-256 KiB S3 checkpoint/parquet objects with periodic 50% bulk TTL expiration sweeps

spec.name: small_fragmented_subblock
spec.description: Small 512 B-1.5 KiB objects packed inside shared 4 KiB filesystem blocks with interleaved deletes

boundary_regimes.name: sub_block_fragmentation_no_reclaim
boundary_regimes.hypothesis: Deleting interleaved 512 B objects inside shared 4 KiB filesystem blocks yields 0 reclaimed OS blocks under direct hole-punching; only copy-compaction (or adaptive fallback) reclaims physical disk space.
boundary_regimes.observation: blind_subblock_discard_negative issued 512 PunchHole calls and reclaimed 0 OS bytes (final space amp 2.23x); discogc_adaptive_discard detected sub-block dead space and fell back to 1 compaction cycle(s) (final space amp 1.66x).

boundary_regimes.name: extent_map_fragmentation_tax
boundary_regimes.hypothesis: Checkerboard alternating 8 KiB deletes produce hundreds of non-contiguous hole extents when hole-punching is uncapped; imposing MaxExtentFragments bounds extent-tree fragmentation via periodic defragmentation at a small one-time copy cost.
boundary_regimes.observation: uncapped punch-hole left 256 extent fragments (LWA 1.01x, scan 158.7 MiB/s); bounded DisCoGC (cap=64) defragmented to 61 fragments (LWA 3.27x, scan 192.1 MiB/s).

boundary_regimes.name: append_only_zero_delete_workload
boundary_regimes.hypothesis: When delete and overwrite rates are 0%, no GC work occurs and all 5 policies yield identical Logical WAF (~1.00x), zero reclaimed blocks, and identical space amplification.
boundary_regimes.observation: All 5 policies produced identical Logical WAF (1.1297x), 0 copied live bytes, 0 reclaimed blocks, and final space amplification 1.13x.
